summary: The issuer filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 35,555 units consisting of two shares of common stock and one warrant, aggregating gross proceeds of $639,990 at $18.00 per unit. The warrants are exercisable at $11.24 beginning June 5, 2027, with a redemption feature if the stock trades at or above $17.98 for 20 out of 30 days. MDB Capital acts as placement agent; a conflict exists as MDB Holdings owns 43.9% of outstanding stock and its directors also serve on the board. The filing is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation such as a acquisition or restructuring; no corporate event triggering special-situation classification is present.
